python3 << 'EOF'
# Data from Treasury Bulletin - Calendar year interest-bearing debt for Series E and EE
nominal_1992 = 144724  # millions
nominal_1993 = 158633  # millions
nominal_1994 = 166731  # millions

# BLS CPI-U annual average values (official)
# These are the standard reference values for CPI-U
cpi_1992 = 140.3
cpi_1993 = 144.5
cpi_1994 = 148.2

# Convert to constant 1994 dollars
# Formula: Real Value = Nominal Value × (CPI_base_year / CPI_nominal_year)
real_1992 = nominal_1992 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1992)
real_1993 = nominal_1993 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1993)
real_1994 = nominal_1994 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1994)  # base year, no adjustment needed

print("=== Inflation-adjusted values (constant 1994 dollars) ===")
print(f"1992: {real_1992:.2f} million")
print(f"1993: {real_1993:.2f} million")
print(f"1994: {real_1994:.2f} million")

# Calculate sample z-score for 1994 value
# Sample mean
values = [real_1992, real_1993, real_1994]
n = len(values)
mean = sum(values) / n

# Sample standard deviation (using n-1)
variance = sum((x - mean)**2 for x in values) / (n - 1)
std_dev = variance ** 0.5

print(f"\n=== Statistics ===")
print(f"Mean: {mean:.2f}")
print(f"Std Dev (sample, n-1): {std_dev:.2f}")

# Z-score for 1994
z_score = (real_1994 - mean) / std_dev

print(f"\n=== Z-score for 1994 ===")
print(f"Z-score: {z_score:.2f}")
EOF
